mapper.sql: SELECT a.alarm_id, a.server_id, a.alarm_type, a.alarm_level, a.message, a.state_cd, a.occur_dt, a.ack_user, a.ack_dt, a.action_memo, a.close_dt, s.system_nm, s.ip_addr, s.fqdn, n.location_nm FROM tb_alarm a INNER JOIN tb_server s ON s.server_id = a.server_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_net_node n ON n.node_id = s.switch_node_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.state_cd IN ('OPEN', 'ACK') ORDER BY CASE a.alarm_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE a.state_cd WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.occur_dt DESC, a.alarm_id DESC

choose.when: SELECT TOP ${maxRows} a.alarm_id, a.server_id, a.alarm_type, a.alarm_level, a.message, a.state_cd, a.occur_dt, a.ack_user, a.ack_dt, a.action_memo, a.close_dt, s.system_nm, s.ip_addr, s.fqdn, n.location_nm FROM tb_alarm a INNER JOIN tb_server s ON s.server_id = a.server_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_net_node n ON n.node_id = s.switch_node_id WHERE a.state_cd = 'CLOSED' AND a.close_dt >= #{since} ORDER BY a.close_dt DESC, a.alarm_id DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT x.alarm_id, x.server_id, x.alarm_type, x.alarm_level, x.message, x.state_cd, x.occur_dt, x.ack_user, x.ack_dt, x.action_memo, x.close_dt, x.system_nm, x.ip_addr, x.fqdn, x.location_nm FROM ( SELECT a.alarm_id, a.server_id, a.alarm_type, a.alarm_level, a.message, a.state_cd, a.occur_dt, a.ack_user, a.ack_dt, a.action_memo, a.close_dt, s.system_nm, s.ip_addr, s.fqdn, n.location_nm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.close_dt DESC, a.alarm_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_alarm a INNER JOIN tb_server s ON s.server_id = a.server_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_net_node n ON n.node_id = s.switch_node_id WHERE a.state_cd = 'CLOSED' AND a.close_dt >= #{since} ) x WHERE x.rn <= #{maxRows} ORDER BY x.rn

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_alarm (server_id, alarm_type, alarm_level, message, state_cd, occur_dt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{alarmType}, #{alarmLevel}, #{message}, 'OPEN', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_alarm SET state_cd = 'ACK', ack_user = #{ackUser}, ack_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, action_memo = #{actionMemo} WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND state_cd IN ('OPEN', 'ACK')
